subject.title: feat(apps): review durable approvals on mobile

question: Do the mobile approval authorization, legacy Gateway v4 fallback, and byte-exact credential/TLS owner migrations preserve the intended shipped trust and upgrade boundaries?
rationale: The branch deliberately changes who may review approvals and how shipped credentials, TLS pins, and fallback RPC behavior are selected; tests cannot establish the permanent trust and compatibility policy without owner intent.

options.title: Approve with proof
options.body: Confirm these trust and fallback semantics, then require exact-head green validation and redacted real-device cross-surface proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow this increment
options.body: Move owner-key or legacy-fallback changes not strictly required for mobile approval review into separately reviewed compatibility work.

recommendation.title: Approve with proof
recommendation.body: Confirm these trust and fallback semantics, then require exact-head green validation and redacted real-device cross-surface proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Merged history shows the strongest ownership signal across every central native-client and Gateway connection surface in this decision.
